# tennis-analytics

Interactive Data Visualizations & Open ATP Analytics Warehouse (1968–2026).

## Overview
`tennis-analytics` hosts interactive ATP data stories powered by `sorukumar/tml-data` (200,105 ATP matches, 7,622 players, 113,744 H2H matchups, plus 7,663 Match Charting Project charted matches) and exposed programmatically to AI agents via `sorukumar/tennis-mcp`.

## Key Modules & Insights
- **Slam Performance (GSDI)** (`/gsdi/`):
  - *Insight*: Identifies the most mathematically "unbeatable" championship runs. Highlights **Bjorn Borg** as the "Don Bradman of tennis," a player whose statistical peak rivaled Nadal's clay dominance and who could have been the GOAT had he continued playing past age 26.
- **India's Tennis Journey** (`/indianplayers/`):
  - *Insight*: Analyzes the "Singles Gap." While India peaked in the 70s-80s (Amritraj era), data shows a modern struggle for Top 100 singles presence despite sustaining world-class doubles excellence.
- **Nail-Biter Index** (`/nbi/`):
  - *Insight*: Mathematically ranks match drama. Identifies the **2019 Wimbledon Final** as the most exciting match ever played. Highlights the **Alcaraz-Sinner Roland Garros** clash as a new benchmark for modern tension.
- **Greatness Race** (`/greatness/`):
  - *Insight*: Tracks titles vs. age. Confirms Nadal was a prodigy; Federer was a late starter compared to his Big 3 peers.
- **Young Guns** (`/young-guns/`):
  - *Insight*: Age-for-age trajectory scouting for Joao Fonseca, Jakub Mensik, Learner Tien, and Rafael Jodar against Alcaraz and Sinner benchmarks.
- **GS Breakthrough** (`/gs-breakthrough/`):
  - *Insight*: Visualizes the "Age Wall." Data proves that 90% of Grand Slam champions win their first trophy before age 27.
- **Brutal Tennis** (`/viz/brutaltennis.html`):
  - *Insight*: Reveals the harsh economy of tennis. Only 1 in 2,500 high school players turn pro. 50% drop out within 2 years due to costs.
- **Geography** (`/globaltop100evolution/`):
  - *Insight*: Maps the 50-year talent shift from Western strongholds to a fully globalized competitive landscape.

## Data & MCP Access
- Parquet & JSON warehouse: https://github.com/sorukumar/tml-data
- Standalone MCP Server (`uvx`): https://github.com/sorukumar/tennis-mcp

## Tech Stack
- JavaScript (D3.js v7, ECharts), Python (Data Prep, DuckDB, Parquet).
- Custom `ExportEngine` for high-quality video generation.
